blocks.text: Zinda rehne ke liye har janwar ko apne aas paas ki duniya se jura rehna parta hai. Use mahol (environment) ki tabdeeliyan mehsoos karni hoti hain aur un ka jawab (response) dena hota hai. Us ke aaza (organs) aur systems ke kaam bhi aapas mein murattab (coordinated, yaani ek doosre ke saath mila kar chalaye gaye) hote hain. Maslan dil ki dharkan (heart rate), saans ki raftar, hazma (digestion) aur bohat se doosre kaam coordinated hote hain. Isi coordination ki wajah se har kaam jism ki zaroorat ke mutabiq qaboo (regulate) hota hai. Insanon aur doosre pecheeda (complex) janwaron mein coordination ki do qismein hain:

items: Nervous coordination, jise nervous system qaboo karta hai
Chemical coordination, jise endocrine system qaboo karta hai

blocks.text: Yeh chapter insani nervous system ko tafseel se bayan karta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Apne jism ko ek bara aur pecheeda shehar samjhein. Shehar theek chalne ke liye traffic lights, emergency services aur bijli ghar (power plants) sab ko aapas mein "baat" karni parti hai. Yahi "baat cheet" coordination kehlati hai.

Nervous coordination mein nervous system bahar ke mahol ke saath aur jism ke mukhtalif hisson ke darmiyan coordination qaboo karta hai. Nervous coordination barqi (electrical) signals ke zariye hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Insanon mein coordination ki do qismein aur har ek ko qaboo karne wala system batayein.
blocks.explanation: Nervous coordination: nervous system qaboo karta hai (barqi signals se). Chemical coordination: endocrine system qaboo karta hai (hormones se).

items: Coordination ki do qismein: nervous (nervous system, barqi signals) aur chemical (endocrine system).
